name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 8 times in 4 visits over 33 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2026-06-08, at wavelengths from 0.97 to 4.78 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
